newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises then slips, NYSE sets program curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises then slips, NYSE sets program curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips spiked higher and then backtracked in suddenly choppy mid-afternoon activity that saw New York Stock Exchange program trading curbs triggered for the first time this session.

The Dow industrials gained 55 points to peak at 7269, triggering the NYSE's index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1435 EDT/1835 GMT. The blue chip average then quickly retraced its steps, retreating to 7250, up 35 points, just minutes later.

The Dow's quick reversal was attributable at least in part to a sell program that began just as blue chips were peaking, according to Birinyi Associates. The firm had not yet calculated the size or impact of the trade.
